mapper.select: SELECT TOTAL - FROZEN - USED FROM OA_BUDGET WHERE DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND MONTH = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyymm')
mapper.update: UPDATE OA_BUDGET SET FROZEN = FROZEN + #{amount} WHERE DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND MONTH = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyymm')
UPDATE OA_BUDGET SET FROZEN = FROZEN - #{amount} WHERE DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND MONTH = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyymm')
UPDATE OA_BUDGET SET FROZEN = FROZEN - #{amount}, USED = USED + #{amount} WHERE DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND MONTH = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyymm')
